TextBlock.Text: Vicia: This rock is so unusual, it appears to float on the surface of this planet's waters!
Thimble: Indeed, I have never seen anything like it. Perhaps we should take some back with us.
Malva: It would be best for us to properly explore beneath sea level before we make plans to take anything back with us.
Vicia: Let's get ready then. We should have plenty of oxygen in our tanks to thoroughly explore the bottom.
